# Acme Tasks

<!-- noodle-app-package source:aaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaa surface:bbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbb -->

## When to use this product
- A user asks to review their work.
- A user asks to complete work.

## Workflows

### Review then complete work

Review the work before making a change.

1. `resource:task_details` — Start with the current task details.
2. `tool:complete_task` — Complete only the task the user selected. (write; destructive; confirmation required)

## Boundaries
- Do not invent task IDs.
- Ask before completing ambiguous work.

## Examples
- “Review my open task.” — use `review_then_complete`.

## MCP surface

[Read the MCP surface reference.](references/mcp-surface.md)

# Acme Tasks MCP surface

Authentication: required (OIDC).

## Tools

| Tool | Description | Behavior | Visibility |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `complete_task` | Complete a selected task. | write; destructive; confirmation required | model |
| `list_tasks` | List the current tasks. | read-only; idempotent | model and app |
| `refresh_widget` | Refresh the app widget. | write; idempotent; open-world | app only |

## Resources

| Resource | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `task_details` | Current details for one task. |

## Prompts

| Prompt | Description | Arguments |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `summarize_tasks` | Summarize the current work. | `period` (required) |

## Widgets

| Widget | Description | Opening tool |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `task_widget` | Task widget | Open with `list_tasks`. |
